verdict.rationale: A state revenue agency could plausibly publish a public data API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive portals, a 1099 XML upload format that follows IRS schemas, and a link to a separate Open Data Portal search. It documents no published endpoints, key-issuance path or rate limits, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
